onlinePrepay: Use PayPal Checkout with intent AUTHORIZE after fare/request review
Persist PayPal order ID and authorization ID against the Pulse Ride ID
Driver decline voids authorization and creates no payment obligation
Driver acceptance may leave funds authorized until ride completion
Ride completion captures the authorized amount server-side
If capture fails, mark UNPAID and send payment-due receipt

venmo.role: supported business payment option and fallback direct-pay lane

inPerson: Use Venmo/PayPal Tap to Pay on driver's phone as post-ride fallback
Record payment method as TAP_TO_PAY and mark PAID after successful in-person payment
Keep quoted ride fare separate from any configurable post-ride convenience fee

postRideFee.rule: Do not enable the requested 5% post-ride fee until card-network, PayPal/Venmo terms, and Vermont surcharge compliance are verified. Build the field/configuration path now without activating it.

unpaidLogic: Completion receipt shows Paid or Payment due
If completed ride remains unpaid, flag rider email/phone with balance due
Block or warn on the next request until prior balance is resolved
Allow driver/admin to mark WAIVED when appropriate
security: Keep PayPal client secret server-side only
Use PayPal request IDs/idempotency for authorize/capture calls
Never trust browser-only payment success; verify server-side before marking PAID
